positioning.summary: Full-stack engineer with 15+ years of experience building software in complex, real-world domains. I’m most comfortable working across systems end-to-end; from shaping product ideas to implementing and evolving them in production, often in fuzzy or poorly defined problem spaces. I contribute to architectural decisions, mentor teammates, and help teams navigate difficult technical problems, while staying pragmatic and open to other perspectives.
strengths: End-to-end ownership across frontend and backend
Building and evolving systems in complex environments
Navigating ambiguity and shaping workable solutions
Mentoring engineers and contributing to architectural direction
selectedImpact: Shaped the frontend platform of an industrial plant control system as the primary senior frontend engineer for several years, building and evolving a complex ecosystem of Angular packages used to compose and operate real-world plant configurations, and contributing to architectural decisions including company-wide initiatives such as a shared component library and frontend standards.

Brought in as the first engineer to kick off a spatial computing project for a San Francisco-based startup; built the initial system from scratch using Babylon.js and React, including custom architecture (e.g. integrating RxJS for time-based data and visualization), and later handed off the project to a full-time engineer after establishing a solid foundation.

Helped drive a long-running modernization effort for a New York–based financial education company; evolved a legacy Yii2 backend into a Next.js frontend with an API layer, working across complex integrations (custom e-commerce, third-party learning platform, multiple SSO providers); stepped up to handle client communication, architecture, and team coordination during a critical phase.
recognition: Speaker at FrontKon 2024 (biggest Czech frontend conference)

workExperience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Worked across multiple client projects in a fast-paced consultancy environment, focusing on complex frontend and full-stack systems, often involving exploratory work including AST-based tooling, interactive demos, and rapid prototyping in new technologies.

Took ownership of features and systems end-to-end, often in unfamiliar domains or partially defined problem spaces and contributed to architectural decisions, especially in situations involving legacy systems, external integrations, or non-trivial data flows.
Worked directly with clients to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions, and align technical decisions with real-world constraints.
Stepped in where needed to unblock teams - from resolving technical issues to helping coordinate work or fill gaps in communication.

workExperience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Worked on the core frontend platform of an industrial plant control system, building and evolving a complex ecosystem of Angular packages used by engineers to compose and operate real-world plant configurations across multiple deployments.

Served as the primary senior frontend engineer for several years, contributing to architectural decisions and helping guide the platform’s evolution, including company-wide initiatives such as a shared component library.
Supported engineers building on top of the platform by resolving issues, improving consistency, and translating complex domain requirements into usable and reliable interfaces.

workExperience.title: Software Engineer & Technical Consultant
bullets: Worked across multiple bespoke software projects, contributing to both implementation and early-stage design, including frontend development, API design, and system modeling.

Collaborated directly with clients to gather requirements, translate them into technical specifications (including diagrams and API designs), and shape solutions from initial concepts through delivery.

Took on a range of responsibilities across projects - from frontend engineering and UX wireframing to project coordination - developing a strong foundation in bridging business needs and technical implementation.

workExperience.title: Co-founder & Technical Lead
bullets: Co-created a lightweight CMS platform focused on simplicity and standardized frontend structure for small business websites.
Designed and implemented the system end-to-end, including content management, frontend architecture, and configuration-driven customization.
Maintained and evolved the product over time, balancing usability, flexibility, and low maintenance overhead.

workExperience.title: Frontend Engineer

Developed and maintained frontend features across evolving backend systems (from .NET to PHP-based platforms).
Collaborated with designers and product teams to improve usability and consistency across key user flows.

Contributed to early e-commerce-related projects, which led to a transition into product-focused development.

Delivered frontend solutions under strict constraints, including Bootstrap-based UI and legacy browser support (e.g. IE6).
